angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 232,364 km at 62.24 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 16.0671 +/- 0.0178 mas (same row, RUWE 1.11): 62.24 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.334 +/- 0.01 solar radii from Waalkes et al. 2021, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-122 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161...13W/abstract): 232,364 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.312 +/- 0.007 solar masses from Waalkes et al. 2021, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-122 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161...13W/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3403 +/- 100 K from Waalkes et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-122 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161...13W/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Waalkes et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-122 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161...13W/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-122.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.885, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-122 (pscomppars): spectral type M3 V, from Waalkes et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161...13W/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-122 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.85387, from Waalkes et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161...13W/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-122 (pscomppars): age 2 Gyr, from Waalkes et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161...13W/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-122 (pscomppars): rotation period 72 d, from Waalkes et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161...13W/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-122 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 7.2 km/s, from Waalkes et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161...13W/abstract)
